_evidence: Free-node pool of the sorted draw list, for callers that insert SEVERAL entries per call (0x52822a calls 0x549db9 once per live animation slot, up to 8 times). 0x549d81 builds the pool: 'mov edi,0x831d89; mov [0x831d85],edi' then 255 x 'mov [edi],edi+0x14; add edi,0x14' and a null last link, i.e. 256 linked 0x14-byte nodes at 0x831d89; 0x549db9 pops 'mov edi,[0x831d85]; mov edx,[edi]; mov [0x831d85],edx' whenever the count [0x831d7d] is below 0x100, so the free list always has 0x100-count valid nodes. list_00549db9 gives the head one random 0x14-byte buffer, whose random +0 link faults on the second pop (fault@0x549dfe). Here (compose AFTER list_00549db9; it keeps the count and the used-list head) the head points into the real pool at node 0..7 and nodes 0..15 carry their builder links (node k +0 = 0x831d89+(k+1)*0x14), so at least 9 distinct, acyclic free nodes follow the head: every pop of up to 8 inserts is valid. Nodes +4..+0x10 are written by the insert before the list walk reads +8. Values are the addresses 0x549d81 itself computes (not image bytes).
